title: Settings
description: Manage your account settings and set e-mail preferences.

profile.title: Profile
profile.description: This is how others will see you on the site.
profile.usernameHint: This is your public display name. It can be your real name or a pseudonym.
profile.emailHint: You can manage verified email addresses in your email settings.
profile.bioPlaceholder: Tell us a little bit about yourself
profile.bioHint: You can @mention other users and organizations to link to them.
profile.urlsHint: Add links to your website, blog, or social media profiles.

account.title: Account
account.description: Update your account settings and choose your preferred language.
account.name: Name
account.nameHint: This is the name that will be displayed on your profile and in emails.
account.dobHint: Your date of birth is used to calculate your age.
account.languageHint: Language changes take effect immediately and are stored in a local cookie.

appearance.title: Appearance
appearance.description: Customize the appearance of the app. Automatically switch between day and night themes.
appearance.fontHint: Set the font you want to use in the dashboard.
appearance.themeHint: Select the theme for the dashboard.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.communicationHint: Receive emails about your account activity.
notifications.marketingHint: Receive emails about new products, features, and more.
notifications.socialHint: Receive emails for friend requests, follows, and more.
notifications.securityHint: Receive emails about your account activity and security.
notifications.mobile: Use different settings for my mobile devices
notifications.mobileHint: You can manage your mobile notifications in the mobile settings page.

display.title: Display
display.description: Turn items on or off to control what's displayed in the app.
display.sidebarHint: Select the items you want to display in the sidebar.

configDrawer.title: Theme Settings
configDrawer.description: Adjust the appearance and layout to suit your preferences.
configDrawer.resetAll: Reset all settings to default values
configDrawer.themeDescription: Choose between system preference, light mode, or dark mode
configDrawer.sidebarDescription: Choose between inset, floating, or standard sidebar layout
configDrawer.layoutDescription: Choose between default expanded, compact icon-only, or full layout mode
